controles.affirmation: JUDICIAIRE - Sept paroisses cotieres et l'Etat de Louisiane poursuivent les petroliers ; des entites Chevron sont defenderesses dans 35 dossiers
controles.verbatim_source: Seven coastal parishes and the State of Louisiana have filed lawsuits in Louisiana against numerous oil and gas companies seeking remediation damages for coastal erosion [...] Chevron entities are defendants in 35 of these cases.

controles.affirmation: JUDICIAIRE - En avril 2025 un jury a condamne Chevron a 744,6 M$ dans l'affaire Plaquemines (Rozel)
controles.verbatim_source: In April 2025, a jury in a Louisiana state court awarded Plaquemines Parish $ 744.6 million in a trial against Chevron entities (i.e., Plaquemines Parish v. Rozel Operating Co., et al. ('Rozel')).

controles.affirmation: JUDICIAIRE - Seulement 131 M$ sont provisionnes ; Chevron ecrit que payer ces dommages pourrait avoir un effet defavorable significatif sur sa situation financiere
controles.verbatim_source: the company has recorded an accrual of $ 131 million, which the company believes to be a reasonably estimable loss in light of the available defenses [...] To the extent the company is required to pay remediation damages in these cases, it may have a material adverse effect on our financial position and results of operations.

controles.affirmation: JUDICIAIRE - La Cour supreme des Etats-Unis a renvoye la question du tribunal competent en avril 2026 ; aucun jugement definitif executoire a ce jour ; la ste conteste
controles.verbatim_source: In April 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court held that the Plaquemines Parish coastal erosion lawsuit was related to actions taken under federal direction for purposes of the federal-officer removal statute and remanded the matter for further proceedings. [...] The company does not concede the viability of the Rozel jury verdict and plans to appeal any judgment based on that verdict. [...] The state court judge continued a hearing on Plaquemines Parish's motion for entry of judgment on the Rozel trial verdict and stayed that case

controles.affirmation: JUDICIAIRE - Nuance bull : Chevron 'a obtenu le renvoi vers les tribunaux federaux juges plus favorables'
controles.verbatim_source: Most of these cases have been remanded to Louisiana state court. [...] the U.S. Supreme Court held that the [...] lawsuit was related to actions taken under federal direction for purposes of the federal-officer removal statute and remanded the matter for further proceedings. The Louisiana state-court verdict against the company in Rozel remains subject to further judicial proceedings regarding the effect of the Supreme Court's ruling, including potential vacatur and further litigation in federal court. Le document ne dit pas que le renvoi vers le federal est acquis : il parle d'un renvoi 'pour suite de la procedure' et d'une annulation et d'un contentieux federal seulement POTENTIELS. La majorite des 35 dossiers ont au contraire ete renvoyes devant les juridictions d'Etat de Louisiane.
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire : 'a obtenu de la Cour supreme une decision favorable sur la competence federale, qui ouvre la voie a une possible annulation du verdict et a un contentieux devant le juge federal, sans que ce transfert soit acquis'.

controles.verbatim_source: The aggregate purchase price of Hess was approximately $ 48 billion, including 15.38 million shares of Hess common stock purchased in open market transactions in the first quarter of 2025 and 301.25 million shares of Chevron common stock issued as closing consideration in July.
